answer_1.quote: Our main contention is that hallucination can occur in any NLG task, necessitating a thorough examination based on the fundamental principles of text generation from a given prompt. The findings from this study can be applied and extended to various NLP tasks.
answer_1.outputs: Generated text passages in response to prompts

answer_2.quote: Finally, to establish a method for quantifying and to offer a comparative spectrum that allows us to evaluate and rank LLMs based on their vulnerability to producing hallucinations, we propose Hallucination Vulnerability Index (HVI).

answer_4.quote: For the annotation task of the 75,000 text snippets, we utilized Amazon Mechanical Turk (Amazon). We obtain sentence-level annotations for hallucination orientations and categories.
